gen-fs-array-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Array sketches futuristic, precise letters with curves left open at the ends. Pilcrow Rounded handles the warm, tightly spaced work with bent-paperclip strokes, though it won't carry paragraph after paragraph.
gen-fs-array-fs-quicksand: Futuristic and precise up top, Array leaves its curves open, while Quicksand rounds out the text with glassy, bulb-like lowercase. Its single line weight keeps a couple of sentences light and friendly.
gen-fs-array-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of crisp text, its letters held open rather than curled shut. Array handles the precise, futuristic part while Supreme carries a few sturdy lines.
gen-fs-array-manrope: Array draws futuristic, precise letters with open-ended curves and large lowercase eyes. And Manrope settles into a quiet, level beat with bright gaps in its curves, pleasant over a few lines.
gen-fs-array-satoshi: Satoshi has a soaring x-height, a wide-open e and every stroke cut to one width, though not for paragraph after paragraph. Array adds futuristic, precise curves above those uniform strokes.
gen-fs-array-work-sans: Open-ended curves give Array its futuristic, precise look, while Work Sans keeps a marker-like line with c tips that never touch. Array brings precision, Work Sans a constant line; skip long paragraphs.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-poppins: Poppins bends every letter from one loose length of wire. Azeret Mono's fixed-width, code-style letters handle the technical side, with generous tracking, while Poppins brings the tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-fs-be-vietnam-pro-bitter: Dependable and grounded, Bitter shows a very large lowercase eye and a see-through s, while Be Vietnam Pro keeps its strokes constant. The standout is sans-serif daylight set against a slab-serif's firm footing.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-bitter: Bitter reads dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye. Bespoke Slab adds bookish dignity with a high-set midline, while Bitter's slab-serif letters leave a see-through gap in each s.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-inter: Smooth, tube-like lines with hollow-reed counters make the text glide. Inter keeps its joins slim as a pipe cleaner, leaving Bespoke Slab's bookish, dignified serif to carry the character.
